topic: Housing Security Anti Eviction and Urban Land Equity Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 21, Seventh Schedule List III Item 20

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 21 (Right to Shelter - Chameli Singh v. State of U.P. (1996) 2 SCC 549)

findings.limitations: Right to life includes right to shelter and protection against arbitrary forced eviction.

gaps: Absence of statutory prohibition against summary house demolitions without judicial hearing and 90-day notice.
